text: Chosen / not chosen, best piece, tree knapsack, rerooting.
labels: f[u][1] / f[u][0] · green: invited
Tree DP (树形动态规划): the state is a subtree, f[u][…] = the best answer inside u's subtree given some fact about u. A DFS computes the children first (post-order), then combines them at u.
Dance party (P1352): nobody comes together with their direct boss.
f[u][1] = happiness of u + Σ f[v][0] (u comes, so no child comes). f[u][0] = Σ max(f[v][0], f[v][1]) (u stays away, each child is free). Answer max(f[root] [0], f[root][1]). O(n).
The extra index is the fact about u that the parent needs: here, "does u come?". Choose it by asking what the parent's rule depends on.

Same shape: fewest guards so that every edge has a guard at one end (P2016 战略游戏): f[u][1] = 1 + Σ min(f[v][0], f[v][1]), f[u][0] = Σ f[v][1]. Colouring a binary tree with rules (P2585) uses three states per node.

Best connected piece (P1122 最大子树和): every piece has a highest node u, so let f[u] = the best piece whose highest node is u. Each child subtree is either attached (if its best piece is positive) or cut off.
This is the tree version of "best block ending here" (第13章): extend when it helps, otherwise start fresh. The answer is max f[u] over all u, not f[root].

Choose m nodes with the most value, where a node may only be chosen if its parent is (P2014 选课 : a course needs its prerequisite). f[u][j] = the best value using j nodes inside u's subtree, with u chosen.
Merging a child is a group knapsack: give the child t of the j slots.
Loop j downward while merging a child (each child used once, like 0/1), and keep slot 1 for u itself. Bounding j by the sizes merged so far makes the whole DP O(n · m) instead of O(n · m²).
Courses without a prerequisite hang below a virtual root 0, so the forest becomes one tree. The root itself always takes one slot, hence f[0][m + 1].

Edge version: keep q branches of an apple tree (P2015 二叉苹果树): count edges instead of nodes. Budget version: TV network (P1273) maximises users with total profit ≥ 0, f[u][j] = best profit with j users.

Rerooting (换根 DP): the answer is needed with every node as the root. Compute it once for root 1 (first DFS), then move the root across each edge u → v and fix the answer in O(1) (second DFS). Total O(n) instead of O(n²) (P2986).

Moving the meeting point from u to v over an edge of length w: the cnt[v] cows on v's side each walk w less, the other total − cnt[v] cows each walk w more. The centroid distance sum of 第9章 is the same trick with all weights 1.
Expected values on a DAG; doubling then shortest paths.

On a general graph, DP works when the states form a DAG: process them in topological order. If the graph has cycles, first shrink the strongly connected components (第12章), or find a quantity that only grows (time, distance, a counter) and make it part of the state.

Expected value on a DAG: f[u] = expected remaining length from u. From u each of the d out-edges is equally likely, so f[u] = Σ (w + f[v]) / d. The end has f = 0; fill f backwards (reverse topological order, or memoised search).

The frog (P4316) chooses each outgoing road with equal probability. Linearity of expectation: the expected length is the average of (road + expected rest). Here f[3] = 4, f[2] = 7, f[1] = ((1 + 7) + (2 + 4)) / 2 = 7.
Go backwards from the end: the forward probability of reaching each node is harder to combine. Memoised search gives the reverse topological order for free.

The runner (P1613) covers 2k km in one second. A DP over powers of two (doubling, 第3章) finds every pair joined by a walk of exactly 2k edges; each such pair is one second apart; Floyd then gives the fewest seconds.
The loop "2k = 2k−1 + 2k−1 through some middle t" is the DP; the result is a new graph on which an ordinary shortest path runs. Here the loop at 1 makes 1 → 1 → 2 → 3 → 4 exactly 4 = 2² steps.

More graph DP shapes: collect mushrooms on a graph with cycles (P2656): shrink SCCs, sum each one's repeated picks, then longest path on the DAG. Count shortest-ish routes in a park (P3953 逛公园): state (node, extra length ≤ K) with memoised search, and a zero-weight cycle in the reachable part means infinitely many.
